headline: Fresh Strongpoint Turns Flare Across Weathered Expanse and LinnMercy
war_summary: Fresh fighting has broken the midday lull in Weathered Expanse and LinnMercy. Weathered Expanse logged six strongpoint events in the latest two hours, Frostmarch alone having changed hands twenty-three times in the day, and its nine posts now stand five Warden, three Colonial and one unclaimed. LinnMercy, quiet at noon, has posted fresh turns at Lathair, which has seen twenty changes in the day; the sector now runs ten Colonial posts to one Warden. Godcrofts also reported fresh strongpoint activity shortly after noon but has since gone quiet. Mooring County, after its earlier three events, has not moved anew; Farranac Coast and Fisherman's Row remain dormant at base level. Stlican Shelf still stands six Warden posts to three Colonial, while Stonecradle has recorded no recent change of ownership despite heavy casualties. Callahans Passage and Nevish Line continue to grind out severe casualty returns without a recorded change of strongpoint ownership. No faction has yet been declared winner, and the war remains undecided.
